title: Great Food Tour
text:
Our tour guide Lars was very informative and helpful in explaining how we could make this experience more enjoyable.
He took us to some out of the way places and had us enjoy some of his favorite spots. Amazing food and atmosphere.
He is an amazing young man with a passion for what he loves.
author: Denny_S

title: Great Food tour
text: Christina was so much fun and very knowledgeable about the area.  The tastings were great and we learned a good bit.  Would highly recommend.
author: Jason_G

title: Maria was the perfect host!!
text: We had such a great time with Maria!  She was born and raised in Barcelona and shared her culture and family story with us and took us all over Barcelona to experience the food and neighborhoods.   She went the extra mile and we had a great time!
author: Alan_S

title: History and tasty food
text: Adi was our guide and it was spectacular! A little bit of history, culture and FOOD! The stories behind everything just topped off the experience. A must do for your first trip to Barcelona.
author: FARPAN

title: A tour not to miss!
text: Alan is amazing! Five stars does not do him justice. This was so much more than a food tour. Although food was absolutely delicious with choice of venues superb, Alan supplied us with his wealth of knowledge. Not only the history of the food but history of Barcelona as well! This tour is not to miss! Even if you have time for only one tour, THIS IS IT!
author: Diana_C

title: .Ellen Skaggs
text: the guide was very well informed on the food and the town. We got to see a lot. Food id a big event in Spain
author: Ellen_S

title: Great food tourn
text: Great food tour!  Lucy was awesome and started us with churros!!  We ate, we laughed, we learned…all what we wanted!
author: Masha_h

title: Be prepared to taste wine...
text: Be prepared to taste wine and interesting local dishes. If it is raining, bring an umbrella. Enjoy the gothic neighborhood.
author: Beth_N

title: Excellent first day of...
text: Excellent first day of trip tour. Alessandro is very knowledgeable and gave us a bunch of information and other ideas for our weeklong Barcelona vacation. Tremendous local knowledge, Spanish history and lots of good restaurant ideas. Other food tours we have done have us pop into a place and try one food and then move onto the next. This tour we did two stops and liked this format. Gave us time to be a more relaxed tour and not rushed. 5 stars
author: Kyle_H

title: Great food tour
text: We had the most fabulous guide (Lusi). We learned a lot about the history of the places as well as recommendations where to go on our stay.  The food we tried was delicious and plentiful.
author: Kaye_M
